title: crassula obovata var. dregeana
intro: Crassula obovata var. dregeana, commonly known as Jade Plant or Money Plant, is a succulent plant species in the family Crassulaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and improving air quality by removing pollutants. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Jade Plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
